firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
I am getting a generic “Kaggle Error” when submitting an ARC-AGI-3 notebook.

I performed a controlled test using a completely new Kaggle notebook with a minimal random agent and the official ARC framework/gateway pattern. The notebook completed successfully in Save & Run All (Commit) mode.

Commit output:

Successfully installed arc-agi-0.9.8 arcengine-0.9.3 pillow-12.2.0
Official ARC package installation completed.
Created /tmp/my_agent.py
Commit artifact created.

  row_id game_id  end_of_game  score
0    1_0       1         True      1

Valid commit artifact
Rows: 1
Size: 2648 bytes

However, submitting the committed version fails with:

Kaggle Error
A system error. Please try resubmitting to resolve the error and contact Kaggle Support if it persists.

Notebook:
https://www.kaggle.com/code/mayakaripel/test-arc?scriptVersionId=350908628



This also happened with my previous notebook, but this new test uses a fresh notebook and a minimal random agent, so the failure does not appear to be related to my adaptive agent or old notebook code.

There is no competition traceback or useful rerun log available.

Has anyone successfully submitted an ARC-AGI-3 notebook recently? Is there a known issue with the competition gateway or submission queue?
